title: Pupil progress dashboard with skill mastery heatmap
summary: Server-side persistence of G1's per-pupil-per-worksheet companion-answer-log, plus a per-pupil heatmap of (specRef × correct/partial/incorrect) and a per-class roll-up. Builds on the existing client-side attemptLog.ts and coverageAggregator.ts.

in: server/db/schema.sql — new pupil_attempt table (school_id, pupil_id, worksheet_id, section_index, spec_ref, status: 'correct'|'partial'|'incorrect', attempted_at)
server/routes/pupilAttempts.ts (new) — POST /api/pupil-attempts (idempotent on (pupil_id, worksheet_id, section_index, attempted_at)) + GET /api/pupil-attempts/dashboard?pupilId=&since=
client/src/lib/companion-answer-log.ts (extend G1's helper) — POSTs to the new endpoint when online; queues offline
client/src/lib/pupilProgressAggregator.ts (new, ~150 LoC) — pure aggregator producing { perPupil, perClass, perSpecRef } summaries
Targeted vitest for the aggregator (deterministic, idempotent, handles empty input)
out: Per-attempt rich detail view (deferred — v1 is roll-ups only)
Cross-school benchmarks (deferred; needs aggregation across schools and a privacy review)

acceptance_criteria: POST endpoint is idempotent — submitting the same (pupil_id, worksheet_id, section_index) row twice updates the existing row instead of creating a duplicate.
GET /api/pupil-attempts/dashboard returns at most 100 attempts per pupil per query (paginated) with a 304 ETag when no new data.
Heatmap colours: green ≥80% correct on a specRef, amber 50-79%, red <50%. Cells with <3 attempts show grey ('insufficient data').
Aggregator is pure: same input rows → same summary across two runs.
Per-class roll-up surfaces top-3 weakest specRefs and links each to a one-click 'Generate re-teach pack' button (which calls H10).

risk_register.risk: PII concerns — pupil_attempt rows include indirectly identifying data
risk_register.mitigation: pupil_id is a per-school anonymous ID generated at companion share time; never stores name. Logger redacts via existing PII redaction (PR-9).
30-day rolling deletion via a daily cron. Schema includes attempted_at index for efficient deletion.
